scenarios.purpose: Validate nominal service, cost and operating posture.
Compare elasticity, buffering, back-pressure and rate-limiting behavior.
Compare isolation, timeout, retry, fallback and recovery behavior.
Expose failure-domain, replication and failover assumptions.
Evaluate offline, synchronization and idempotency posture.
Evaluate hostile traffic, identity, audit and detection posture.
Evaluate architecture fit against reduced delivery and operations capacity.
Evaluate resilience and service targets under reduced budgets.
Evaluate configurable LLM routing, fallback and local-model continuity.

limitation: Comparative deterministic simulation is decision support, not a capacity, cost, security or availability guarantee. Calibrate with measured production evidence.
